items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: He used to call me Israel... Then he changed it. I told him to cut it out. So he called me Simon... But he was funny. He was the best company in the world.

ctx.x: And all of a sudden the band, I had no background.

They were all crying, they were laughing so much. He used to call me Israel. He said I was Jewish, I had Jewish instincts, he meant the money. Then he changed it. I told him to cut it out. So he called me Simon. And I said, what the hell did you get on those names? He said, Simon Legree, I was supposed to be Simon Legree.
So a lady said to me, are you Jewish?
